text:
Alex: Quick sync on OnCorridor IAC starter kit for Cloud Partner Y. Aim: lightweight Terraform templates + reference arch + CI examples. Target publish date May 3.
Priya: got it. Proposal: narrow scope to GCP (GKE) + AWS (EKS) but ship GKE first for partner pilot. Keep IAM and secrets minimal.
Jorge: I'll prototype modules: vpc, cluster, autoscaling_node_pool, alb/ingress, kms. Will add inputs/outputs docs. ETA Apr 22 for initial PR.
Li: I'll handle CI workflows. Plan: `validation/plan.yml` for terraform plan, `validation/apply.yml` gated to sandbox project with short TTL. Need service account from partner.
Hana: I'll draft the reference architecture diagram and include a short data residency note. Also add a "what's included" checklist for the partner page.
Alex: Nice. Partner asked for an example showing both low-cost and perf configs side-by-side. Can we include two example variables files?
Jorge: yes, examples/cost-optimized.tfvars and examples/low-latency.tfvars. Will include comments explaining tradeoffs.
Priya: quick code snippet we should surface in README for partners to copy: 
```
module \"oncorridor_cluster\" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood/oncorridor-iac.git//modules/gke"
  name = "oncorridor-${var.partner_id}"
  node_count = var.node_count
}
```
Li: CI snippet for reviewers: `terraform init && terraform validate && terraform plan -compact-warnings` in a GH Actions job.
DeployBot: FYI: marketplace-metadata-ticket created PROC-7890 (owner: Alex).
Alex: Action list:
 - Jorge: TF modules + examples (due Apr 22)
 - Li: GH Actions + sandbox apply docs (due Apr 20)
 - Hana: diagram + partner-facing checklist (due Apr 18)
 - Priya: marketplace blurb + screenshots (due Apr 25)
Alex: Also need to document hardware compatibility notes (Arm/Graviton/Ampere). For now mark as "coming soon" in README and add an appendix later.
Jorge: Will enforce stable outputs: cluster_name, kubeconfig_secret, node_pool_ids. We'll version modules with `v1.x` tag.
Priya: marketplace screenshot plan: 2 screenshots + 15-20s gif of deploy. I'll mock up this week.
Hana: setting up partner kickoff call Fri 11am PT. Invite sent.
Li: small ask: include terraform.lock and recommended provider versions so partners don't hit drift.
Alex: agreed. Also add a short troubleshooting FAQ: common errors, IAM perms, quota checks.
DeployBot: Checklist: repo-skeleton (open), modules (open), CI (open), examples (open), marketplace-assets (open).
Priya: I'll volunteer to publish the initial marketplace tile once content is merged.
Jorge: PR note 1: include `examples/README.md` that describes quickstart steps and `deploy.sh` helper.
Alex: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the initial PRs. :ship:
